measurement_basis: pushed Control implementation and focused cross-repository verification

observation.source_interface: MNCS Control project continuation and Environment authority evaluation

outcome.implementation_change: Unique project-session selection no longer fails solely because another continuation carries a held claim. Control reports bounded overlap, incomplete, or clear claim-observation state and leaves mutation eligibility to Environment's current exact-scope checks.
outcome.effectiveness_assessment: selection and mutation-boundary behavior verified; live multi-agent reduction in coordination effort not yet observed
outcome.analysis_limit: No claim was transferred or recovered. Duplicate session identities and incomplete continuation inventories remain unresolved rather than being selected by arbitrary order.
